final: WITH player_groups AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(points_won * 1.0 / points_max) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_award_vote GROUP BY player_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM player_groups), kept AS (SELECT pg.avg_ratio, pg.record_count, o.avg_count FROM player_groups AS pg JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND pg.record_count > o.avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(record_count), AVG(record_count - avg_count) FROM kept
